label: managerial or leadership office in
definition: X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or institution Y, such as head, leader, president, manager, director, executive or chair.
scope_notes: Preserves prior managerial/leadership office scope, including public executive roles. Founding, ownership, ordinary employment, campaigning or sporting lead alone is insufficient. Competing predicates are retained as errors, not added to the definition.
